description: This Python source file defines API route handlers for a compatibility layer that forwards requests to version 1 handlers. It imports FastAPI components, models and services from v1, and sets up endpoints for creating, deleting, uploading assets, analyzing jobs, fetching statuses and results, fixing assets, and downloading artifacts, all serving as URL alias wrappers for existing v1 functionality.
